attempts.assert_evidence: AssertionError: served a rate older than an hour
attempts.output:
I added an in-process cache for each currency pair in `fx/convert.py`'s `rate()`. Each entry expires after 5 minutes (`TTL = 300`). Both tests pass, including a new one that checks a repeated call is served from the cache and a fetch happens again once the TTL has passed.

I can't guarantee "never older than an hour". The treasury API response carries no publish time, so the cache can only count age from when we fetched. A rate fetched just before the next publish could be up to about 1h05 old by the time its entry expires. If the API exposes a publish timestamp, use that for expiry instead and the guarantee becomes exact.

The cache lives in each process, so every worker fetches its own copy. Two workers that miss at the same moment will both call the API; I didn't add locking for that.
